Who and what is in this chapter
Stone fortresses, fortified cities, ancient ruins and dangerous wilderness shape a world of constant conflict.
Soldiers fight with swords, shields, bows and siege weapons, while wizards command powerful elemental magic.
The first chapter introduces two forces. Fire represents destruction and raw power. Stone represents endurance, protection and strength.
